scenarios.name: ordinary-chat-native
scenarios.input: ordinary chat turn with no explicit Codex harness
scenarios.expected: native loop completes without creating a Task Ledger root or entering /loop
scenarios.negative: ordinary chat must not create a Task Ledger root or enter /loop
scenarios.notRunReason: native ordinary-turn negative is covered by source-level policy tests; no new full Chat-provider turn was run in TF-0570

scenarios.name: normal-codex-turn
scenarios.input: explicit/policy Codex app-server turn with isolated CODEX_HOME
scenarios.expected: source and packaged managed runtime initialize; an authenticated model turn is not inferred
scenarios.negative: missing app-server binary must not silently fall back after side effects
scenarios.notRunReason: authenticated model turn not-run; managed initialize and missing-binary failure are proven

scenarios.name: explicit-codex-control
scenarios.input: explicit agentHarnessRuntimeOverride=codex while no Codex harness is registered
scenarios.expected: MissingAgentHarnessError is surfaced; no thread is invented and no ACP switch occurs
scenarios.negative: missing bound thread shows an explicit error and never invents a thread
scenarios.notRunReason: bind/resume/steer command execution was not run against a live bound app-server in this node; source plus explicit-missing failure are readback

scenarios.name: packaged-desktop-launch
scenarios.input: release/win-unpacked packaged tree with plugin-local managed Codex runtime
scenarios.expected: packaged binary resolves inside the app payload and initializes; host Codex is not used
scenarios.negative: dev-only pnpm link is not packaged availability

scenarios.name: ci-headless
scenarios.input: strict coding-run/v1 JSONL records without an Electron window
scenarios.expected: unknown fields and invalid sequence are rejected; no Codex CLI compatibility is implied
scenarios.negative: coding-run projection is not a Codex CLI compatibility layer

scenarios.name: acp-alternative
scenarios.input: explicit ACPX Codex adapter initialize and unauthenticated isolated-home negative
scenarios.expected: protocol initialize is observed; absent/unavailable adapter fails closed
scenarios.negative: absent adapter fails closed; no hidden switch to Codex native
scenarios.notRunReason: ACPX Codex prompt turn is recorded separately; generic adapter selection and cancel are not exercised

scenarios.name: alternate-harness-evaluation
scenarios.input: OpenCode local binary plus ACPX Codex and native comparison fields
scenarios.expected: quality/latency/cost remain explicitly not-run; no adoption claim
scenarios.negative: a third-party demo is not proof of equivalent permissions/cost/quality
scenarios.notRunReason: OpenCode model turn failed before turn; currency cost not-run

scenarios.name: versebrowser-task
scenarios.input: real embedded browser: open -> observe -> act -> re-observe -> verify
scenarios.expected: saved value is read back; private-network/forged approval/unsupported facade fail closed
scenarios.negative: harness cannot bypass private-network denial or approval

scenarios.name: verseshell-execution
scenarios.command: pnpm --dir openclaw_runtime exec vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.verseshell.config.ts src/agents/verseshell/governed-process.real-limits.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scenarios.input: bundled ae.exe with no cap, maxProcesses=1, and 64 MiB commit cap
scenarios.expected: child refusal/allocation failure is observed and receipt reports Job Object enforcement
scenarios.negative: external-write is not a journal-backed rollback

scenarios.name: versegit-concurrent-candidate
scenarios.input: two isolated candidates with verification, permission gate, journaled apply, and five TOCTOU negatives
scenarios.expected: verification precedes first write; all negatives fail closed; VG remains fact/advisory only
scenarios.negative: VG advisory/admitted is not harness verdict or task completion

scenarios.name: failure-fallback
scenarios.input: missing managed binary, isolated unauthenticated Codex, explicit missing Codex harness, and invalid runtime observation
scenarios.expected: every failure is explicit; unknown/stale observations stay unverified; no silent fallback
scenarios.negative: missing binary/auth/timeout must expose failure rather than a successful-looking result
